status: PROPOSED (2026-10-21 UTC), NOT FROZEN. The teacher-native generation protocol for stage2.reasoning_master@v1. It is frozen, with its sha256 recorded in the generation run's authorization, only after the maintainer approves the protocol and a budget. Revised 2026-10-22: the runner chain (generation_plan.py -> generation_driver.py -> generation_adapter.py) is written and tested without a GPU; the source scheme is the maintainer's (stage2.reasoning_master@v1).

teacher._identity_owners: revision and chat template: artifacts/stages/stage-3/corpus_v2/manifest.json and the teacher_cal summary (they agree); tokenizer sha: corpus_v2's manifest (teacher_cal recorded it as null -- a gap this protocol closes by recording it per run)
teacher.think_opening: the chat template's generation prompt opens <think>; nothing is prefilled by hand
teacher.system_message: You are a helpful Assistant. (sessions.SYSTEM_DEFAULT; a source's own system message is kept byte-for-byte)

decoding._preset: the teacher's official recommendation, as corpus_v2 and teacher_cal used
decoding.seed_rule: a distinct recorded seed per candidate and per turn
decoding.candidates: up to 2 per task: the second (seed base + 1) only when the first is rejected, judged on the pod by generation_adapter.candidate (pure Python); none where the verdict needs the dev-box code sandbox; every candidate recorded, tagged with its candidate_index (the pass) and never defaulted

allowance.rule: per turn: session limit 8,184 = block_len 8,192 - 8 (aadistill.data.sessions.completion_budget's margin), minus the rendered prompt (run_battery --session-limit)
allowance.why: a trace that does not fit the 8,192-token training block cannot be trained whole and is never cut (P17), so generating past that point buys nothing; this is a DATA-CONSTRUCTION limit, not a measurement budget (P18 governs measurement)
allowance.consequence_recorded: length_limited candidates are kept in the record with their full token ids, never trimmed into a target; the share of tasks with no admissible trace is reported per stratum and difficulty, because the limit selects against the longest traces

engine.runner: scripts/stages/stage-0/calibration_volume/run_battery.py --mode generate, one subprocess per input group and pass, driven by scripts/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/generation_driver.py over the inputs generation_plan.py writes (run_battery's task contract; a task's own system message is the run's --system)

verification.procedural_static: stages.calibration_volume.score_battery (scorer protocol v2): the boxed final answer against the generator's gold; termination is judged apart from correctness
verification.procedural_episode: environment replay (action protocol v2): success; an illegal action rejects (observation action_legality)
verification.external_generators: the boxed final answer against the generator's gold with the module's declared comparator, or the module's project checker (checkers.py); prontoqa also the reference-proof step check (partial required); a module with neither is never generated
verification.mbpp_train: supporting_verify.code_asserts in the probed sandbox on the dev box
verification.reused_targets: already verified at selection (build_supporting_tasks: final_number / span / no leading abstention); no generation
verification.identity: generation_adapter refuses records without a unique explicit candidate_index or whose messages are not split_generation of their raw output (and token ids decoding to it); the selected record's sha256 travels into the pack's targets.jsonl

never: fabricate, complete or trim a reasoning trace
accept, reject or select a target by its length
replace a teacher target with a public one
use a no-think or empty-think target (P17)
isolation: every task pool passes configs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/isolation_rules.json before any candidate is generated for it
durability: the generation records (token ids included) are pushed off the pod and hash-checked before teardown, as teacher_cal's were; they are small (teacher_cal: 59 MB for 4.5M tokens)
